messages:
Maria: FYI planning an evening release train for 18:30 PT. Payloads: router map update, runtime 1.14.2 kernel tweak, and default batch size change. Canary at 18:30 (5%), ramp to 50% at 18:40, then to 100% by 18:50. Need smoke owners and a rollback watcher for each region (us-west / us-east / eu).

Dave: I can own us-west smoke + immediate rollback if needed. Will tail logs and run the quick checks. :thumbsup:

Anya: EU coverage from me. Ill be on standby from 18:20.

Kevin: I'll monitor infra signals (GPU memory, scheduler queue depth, autoscaling events). I'll be the rollback contact for control-plane issues.

Sam: I will take us-east sanity. If I dont respond in 4m during the canary window, escalate to @Dave.

Dave: Can someone post the exact rollback CLI and the little smoke script you run so I can prep locally?

Maria: Rollback (per-region):
```
deployctl rollback --train rt-2026-03-18-1830 --region <region> --reason "canary-failure"
```
Minimal smoke checklist (aim <3 minutes):
```
1) curl /health -> 200
2) POST /v1/generate with sample prompt (64 tokens) -> 200 and expected json keys
3) p50 latency < 400ms for sample request
4) check GPU mem < 88% on serving nodes for region
5) tail app logs for 90s -> zero panics, <5 unique error traces
```
Local smoke helper I use:
```
#!/bin/bash
curl -sS https://$REGION.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64}' | jq .
```

deploy-bot: Deploy train scheduled: id=rt-2026-03-18-1830, canary=5%, ramp plan=5->50@18:40->100@18:50. Window id=deploy-1768004321.

sre-bot: SLO guardrails: if p50 > 120ms OR error rate > 0.8% for 120s, auto-abort condition will trigger and notify @oncall-sre. Manual abort encouraged if symptoms are broader.

Kevin: I'll spin up a temporary dashboard with GPU mem, p50, and 5xx rate panels. Posting link in 4m.

Anya: Quick Q: If EU canary flaps, do we rollback EU only or hold the global train? What's our decision matrix?

Maria: Default is per-region rollback for region-specific anomalies. Global rollback only if the issue is config-wide (eg router map mismatch) or control plane alarm. Use the `--region` flag for scoped rollback.

Sam: If us-east fails, I'll run the rollback command and post the run id. Dave please forward any stack traces >5 unique errors in 3m to #incidents.

Dave: Understood. Ill start smoke at 18:28 and paste pass/fail here. If I trigger rollback Ill include the CLI output.

Maria: Final notes: be logged in 18:20-18:55, have rollback in clipboard, keep the runbook open: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-train, and react :white_check_mark: when ready to cover.

Dave: :white_check_mark:

Anya: :white_check_mark:

Kevin: :white_check_mark:

Sam: :white_check_mark:

Maria: Thanks team I'll kick the canary at 18:30 PT and post the canary summary at 18:35. If anyone needs to swap coverage, say now.
